title: KEEL TAKEOVER 336
style: happy hardcore, UK hardcore, 175 BPM, four-on-the-floor kick, supersaw stabs, hoover bass, rolling amen-lite breaks, euphoric piano riff, vocal chops only (no lead vocal), pitched-up chants, airhorn fills, sidechained pads, stadium reverb, instrumental
lyrics:
[Instrumental — vocal chops & chants only, no lead vocal]

[Intro — 0:00]
(chop) "three-three-six" "three-three-six"
(chant, distant) "KEEL... KEEL... KEEL"
(riser + airhorn)

[Drop 1 — 0:30]
(chop) "ZYN-KEEL" "ZYN-KEEL"
(chop, pitched) "G4 LENS ON"
(chant) "hey! hey! hey! hey!"
(stab) "three-three-six BLUE"

[Break — 1:00]
(whisper chop) "finich... finich... finich"
(chop) "SONG-PAL" "SING-PAL"
(piano riff)

[Drop 2 — 1:30]
(chop) "McIVOR" "McIVOR"
(chant) "KEEL TAKEOVER"
(chop, stutter) "ZYN-CON-TEXT"
(airhorn)

[Bridge — 2:00]
(chop, slowed) "three... three... six"
(chant) "hold the line"
(filter sweep up)

[Final Drop — 2:30]
(chop) "KEEL! KEEL! KEEL!"
(chant) "G4 LENS ON"
(chop) "three-three-six BLUE"
(stab) "ZYN-KEEL"

[Outro — 3:00]
(chop, fading) "finich... finich..."
(chant, distant) "KEEL..."
(tape stop)
